description:
Electrical diagnostics, electronics repair, and honest tool reviews — for people who'd rather fix it than replace it. Practical tutorials for home electrical troubleshooters, electronics hobbyists, makers, and working techs.

Backed by a background in Air Force avionics, industrial test engineering, and dealership-level automotive diagnostics.

🔧 What you'll learn:
- Electrical diagnostics — multimeter use (Lo-Z, volts, amps, continuity), ghost voltage, parasitic drains, wiring faults
- Test gear reviews — multimeters, test lights, oscilloscopes, clamp meters & diagnostic tools
- Electrical theory made simple — Ohm's law, AC/DC, nominal voltage, battery & load testing
- Automotive diagnostics — the same instruments applied to vehicles: electrical faults, parasitic draws, relative compression

🤝 Tool & test-equipment brands: I produce dedicated reviews, demos & sponsored content. Partnerships & inquiries: lucasmaddox@gmail.com
